scope: Opt-in `coax deps --modules` (coax.modules.v1): conservative module-scoped content and dependency revisions, separate from nominal IDs, physical source hashes and the selected profile. verse/everglade/guard-types.coax claims verse.everglade.guard_types; lookup stays the flat #load behavior.

policy.seed: bootstrap/sources.c and .h refreshed; the bootstrap regenerates them byte for byte

consumers.generated_c_unchanged: The claim sits on the existing GaEffect line, so `coax c --library` output for both entries is byte-identical with and without it (line maps included); C ABI and authored behavior unchanged.

covers: two independently compiled consumers share IDs and revisions
relocation, unrelated graph changes and load order keep the shared module's revision; a reordered owner file changes its own conservatively
layout edits change content and revision but not the nominal ID; dependents' revisions change, their content does not; member body and comment edits change the member's module
unowned units and declarations, generated proto declarations, descriptor dependencies and declaration ranges are named as unavailable or dependencies, never invented

limits: Revisions are module-scoped: any admitted change to a module's members invalidates all of its declarations; exact declaration ranges are r1a-target-spans.
Not a cache key, lockfile or toolchain manifest; build-only stage0 refuses the report.
No qualified lookup or visibility (r1a-qualified-lookup, r1a-public-hud-module).
